history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration inform respective entities to implement the mobile communication services recovery and refund mechanism to ensure non- official mobile communication service costs are recovered and refunded to the regular budget in a timely manner.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology requests that this recommendation be closed. The online billing system issues electronic bills to each user. The default setting for each call listed in the mobile bill is “private”. If a user takes no action, all calls will be billed to the user as private. To move a call from “private” to “official”, a user must follow specific instructions. Otherwise, all calls are charged to the user, who incurs the costs. This is a very efficient and effective way to ensure that private calls are not charged as official calls. The responsibility for accurately reflecting official calls lies with the staff member.
history.board_assessment: Given that the billing system is configured by default to charge private calls, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
